requirements.title: An intrinsic operation requires the values of its operands
requirements.definition: When an intrinsic operation is evaluated, the operation requires the operand values for that intrinsic operation. This value requirement does not impose a left-to-right operand evaluation order and is subject to later rules that permit omission of unneeded expression parts.

pending.unary-intrinsic-operand-value: PENDING positive-control source shape assigning a variable the literal -7 and evaluating unary minus to obtain literal 7. The variable is assigned on a reached path before use so the operand value is non-vacuous without using a side effect inside the operand.
pending.binary-intrinsic-both-operand-values: PENDING positive-control source shape assigning two distinct integer variables and evaluating a-b with literal oracle chosen so changing either operand changes the result. The fixture must not record which operand was evaluated first.
pending.array-intrinsic-element-values: PENDING positive-control source shape assigning two rank-one integer arrays and evaluating array subtraction with literal element oracle. Shape and elementwise application are credited to 10.1.4 p4/10.1.10 dependencies; this facet observes that the intrinsic operation uses operand values.

requirements.oracle: Use operands whose values are established before the expression and whose literal result would change if an operand value were different. Do not use function side effects, undefined values, or evaluation counts as the oracle.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future fixtures must use independently derived literal or inquiry oracles and must not infer evaluation order, short-circuiting, which operand was evaluated, or whether an operand was evaluated. They must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted assembly, undefined reads, or a floating-point result that 10.1.7 or 10.1.8 permits to differ through omitted evaluation or mathematically equivalent rewriting.

requirements.title: Function-reference side effects in a statement are restricted except in listed controlling contexts
requirements.definition: A function reference in the logical expression of an IF statement, the mask expression of a WHERE statement, or the concurrent-limits or concurrent-steps of a FORALL statement is permitted to define variables in the corresponding subsidiary action, WHERE assignment, or FORALL assignment statement. Except in those cases, function-reference evaluation within a statement shall neither affect nor be affected by evaluation of any other entity in the statement, and an actual argument that the function defines or undefines, or any associated entity, shall not appear elsewhere in the same statement.

pending.if-controlling-expression-permitted-defi: PENDING positive-control source shape IF (set_x_true(x)) y=x where the function defines x and returns true. The independent oracle is the literal assigned to y in the reached action; no other same-statement entity interaction is present.
pending.where-mask-permitted-definition: PENDING positive-control source shape WHERE (set_mask_and_x(x)) a=x with scalar or conforming array design kept minimal. The oracle is a literal assignment result in the WHERE assignment and the plan must cite 10.2.3.1 for WHERE execution.
pending.forall-control-permitted-definition: PENDING positive-control source shape FORALL with a concurrent-limit or concurrent-step function that defines a variable also used in the forall-assignment-stmt. The oracle is a small literal array result; the plan must cite 10.2.4 and avoid relying on iteration order.
pending.function-affects-other-entity-restricted: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape like y = g(x) + x where g defines x, paired with a repaired two-statement version that first calls g then uses x with a literal oracle. The negative must isolate this p2 restriction rather than an interface, purity, or argument-intent violation.
pending.function-affected-by-other-entity-restri: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape in which a function reference reads an entity that another evaluation in the same statement defines, with a minimally repaired sequence and literal oracle. The plan must prove the ordinary statement is outside the IF/WHERE/FORALL exceptions.
pending.defined-actual-argument-reappears-restri: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape A(i)=f(i) or y=g(x)+1 where the function defines or undefines the actual argument and that same argument appears elsewhere. Repair separates the reference into a prior statement and checks a literal result.
pending.associated-entity-reappears-restricted: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape where the actual argument's associated entity, such as an associated pointer or host/use-associated object, appears elsewhere in the statement. The repair must preserve association facts and use a literal oracle, not address comparison.

requirements.title: Array constructors evaluate ac-implied-do control scalar integer expressions
requirements.definition: The appearance of an array constructor requires evaluation of each scalar-int-expr of the ac-implied-do-control in every ac-implied-do it contains.

pending.implied-do-initial-expression: PENDING positive-control source shape with an array constructor [(i,i=1+1,4)] and literal array oracle [2,3,4]. The arithmetic in the initial expression changes the first element, making the control evaluation non-vacuous.
pending.implied-do-terminal-expression: PENDING positive-control source shape [(i,i=1,2+2)] with literal array oracle [1,2,3,4]. The terminal expression is independently a small integer literal computation.
pending.implied-do-stride-expression: PENDING positive-control source shape [(i,i=1,5,1+1)] with literal oracle [1,3,5]. The stride expression value changes the sequence, and no function side effects are used.
pending.nested-implied-do-controls: PENDING positive-control source shape with nested ac-implied-do controls whose literal result matrix or flattened array distinguishes inner and outer bounds. Constructor syntax and ac-implied-do grammar remain 7.8 dependencies.

requirements.title: Elemental binary operations on arrays are applied element by element
requirements.definition: When an elemental binary operation is applied to a scalar and an array, or to two arrays of the same shape, the operation is performed element by element on corresponding elements of the array operands.

pending.scalar-left-array-right: PENDING positive-control source shape 10 - [1,2,3] with literal oracle [9,8,7]. Distinct element values make scalar broadcasting and elementwise subtraction non-vacuous.
pending.array-left-scalar-right: PENDING positive-control source shape [1,2,3] - 10 with literal oracle [-9,-8,-7], distinct from the left-scalar case. The oracle is integer literal arithmetic.
pending.same-shape-array-operands: PENDING positive-control source shape [1,2,3] + [10,20,30] with literal oracle [11,22,33]. Declarations establish equal shape; conformability details remain 10.1.10 dependent.
pending.corresponding-element-pairing: PENDING positive-control source shape [1,100] - [10,1] with literal oracle [-9,99] to distinguish corresponding-element pairing from reductions, permutations, or scalar use. No storage-order or address observation is used.

requirements.oracle: Use arrays with distinct literal element values and check both shape and element values through ordinary assignment/inquiry dependencies. No test may infer element evaluation order.

requirements.title: Elemental unary operations on arrays are elementwise, same shape, and order-flexible when pure
requirements.definition: When an elemental unary operator operates on an array operand, the operation is performed element by element and the result has the same shape as the operand. If an elemental operation is intrinsically pure or implemented by a pure elemental function, the element operations may be performed simultaneously or in any order; that latitude is not an observable ordering requirement.

pending.intrinsic-unary-array-values: PENDING positive-control source shape -[1,-2,3] with literal oracle [-1,2,-3]. Distinct signs make elementwise unary application non-vacuous.
pending.unary-result-same-shape: PENDING positive-control source shape applying unary plus or minus to a rank-one and rank-two array and checking SHAPE against independent literals as well as element values. SHAPE inquiry semantics remain 16.9.171 dependent.
pending.pure-elemental-function-array-values: PENDING positive-control source shape with a pure elemental defined unary operator or pure elemental function mapped over an array and returning value+1 for each element. Literal array oracle verifies element results without relying on operation order.
pending.pure-element-order-latitude: PENDING permission-control source shape using only intrinsically pure or pure elemental operations whose result is independent of element order, with literal array oracle. The catalogue records that simultaneous or arbitrary order is allowed; no future case may fail a processor for choosing any permitted order or may use side effects to detect it.

requirements.oracle: Only element values and shape are observable here. The pure-element order sentence is a permission: tests may ensure their expected value is order-independent but must not assert a particular order or simultaneity.

requirements.title: Conditional expressions test scalar logical expressions in order and evaluate the chosen expression
requirements.definition: Evaluation of a conditional-expr evaluates each scalar-logical-expr in order until one is true or none remain. If one is true, its subsequent expr is chosen; otherwise the final expr is chosen. The chosen expr is evaluated and its value is the value of the conditional expression.

pending.first-true-selects-subsequent-expr: PENDING positive-control source shape using a conditional-expr with first condition true and distinct literal result expressions, assigned to an integer with literal oracle for the first subsequent expr. Conditional expression syntax remains 10.1.2.3 owned.
pending.later-true-not-selected-after-earlier-tr: PENDING positive-control source shape with two true literal scalar-logical-exprs and distinct integer expr literals; oracle is the first true branch value. This observes selection, not whether the later condition expression was evaluated by side effect.
pending.no-true-selects-last-expr: PENDING positive-control source shape with all scalar logical conditions false and a distinct final expr literal. The oracle is the final literal value and each nonfinal expr has a different valid literal.
pending.chosen-expr-value-result: PENDING positive-control source shape where the chosen expr is a nontrivial integer computation with independent literal oracle, proving the value comes from evaluating the chosen expr rather than merely parsing a literal.
pending.condition-order-without-side-effects: PENDING boundary source shape using pure literal or inquiry-free conditions whose truth values are known independently. The plan explicitly forbids side-effect counters, undefined variables, or function-call counts as evidence of condition order.

requirements.oracle: Conditional-expression selection can be checked by distinct literal result values. Do not use side effects in conditions or branch expressions to prove skipped evaluation, despite the source rule about chosen evaluation.

requirements.title: Conditional-expression declared and dynamic properties come from its expr operands and chosen expr
requirements.definition: The declared type, kind type parameters, and rank of a conditional-expr are the same as those of its expr operands. Its dynamic type, length type parameters, and shape are those of the chosen expr. A conditional-expr is polymorphic if and only if one or more of its expr operands is polymorphic.

pending.declared-type-from-exprs: PENDING positive-control source shape with integer conditional-expr assigned to INTEGER and checked against a literal value. A contrasting real destination must not be used as a hidden conversion oracle; declared type observation cites assignment rules.
pending.kind-parameter-from-exprs: PENDING positive-control source shape where all expr operands have an explicitly selected integer kind available on the processor and KIND of the result is compared with that named kind literal. KIND semantics remain 16.9.118 dependent.
pending.rank-from-exprs: PENDING positive-control source shape where each expr operand is rank-one and the result is assigned to a rank-one target with literal SHAPE oracle. A scalar contrast belongs to the conditional-expression syntax/type compatibility owner.
pending.dynamic-type-from-chosen-expr: PENDING positive-control source shape with polymorphic declared class and two extension-type expr operands, using SELECT TYPE or SAME_TYPE_AS-dependent inquiry to observe the chosen dynamic type plus a literal component value. Type definition and inquiry owners must be cited.
pending.length-parameter-from-chosen-expr: PENDING positive-control source shape with character expr operands of the same declared type but chosen branches of distinct lengths where allowed by 10.1.2.3, checking LEN and value against independent literals. If the grammar requires same declared length, record that as a dependency before authoring.
pending.shape-from-chosen-expr: PENDING positive-control source shape where possible chosen array exprs have distinguishable shapes under the conditional-expression rules, checking SHAPE and values of the selected result. If same-rank restrictions prevent varying extent in the intended context, keep the facet pending rather than inventing an oracle.
pending.polymorphic-if-any-expr-polymorphic: PENDING positive-control source shape with one polymorphic expr operand and one nonpolymorphic compatible operand, then use a polymorphic-only admissible context or SELECT TYPE with literal branch oracle. The plan must not infer polymorphism from storage layout or compiler diagnostics alone.
